profile.headline: SWE @ Microsoft (Prev @ AST SpaceMobile)
profile.summary: I like solving hard problems and building things that are new. I have multiple engineering degrees and have spent more years self studying and applying various topics in computer science and software engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Developing kernel drivers for Windows in C++/C within the Core Operating Systems Group, directly impacting billions of users globally.

company.name: Microsoft

positions.title: Flight Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Vast’s first Flight Software Engineer hire. 

Vast is developing artificial gravity space stations to expand humanity across the solar system. 

Developed low latency C++ software in a Linux environment for a multitude of modules including device drivers, application software, network-level code, and more, all on-board the Haven-Demo spacecraft and Haven-1 space-station.

company.name: VAST
AST SpaceMobile

positions.title: Flight Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote a large portion of the flight software for the Blue Walker 3 and Blue Bird 1 LEO Satellite Missions to create the world's first space-based cellular broadband network. 

Architected embedded software to meet and exceed mission requirements for Blue Walker 3 LEO Satellite. Developed embedded software with a RTOS on an ARM microprocessor using C++ (and C). Developed application code on custom PCB’s utilizing I2C, CAN-bus, UART and SPI communication protocols. Debugged software using electrical engineering principles in cooperation with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and multimeters, etc. Mentored and trained Associate Engineers, conducted interviews, as well as participated in managerial decisions relating to hiring and tasking. Lead multiple development projects in parallel with other satellite development tasks. Managed and developed tasking schedules for two direct report interns. Tested flight software using Python and Ruby. Supervised one direct report.

positions.title: Avionics and Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: BlueWalker 3 LEO Satellite Mission. Wrote test software in C, C++ and C# to test a custom circuit board. Developed and conducted validation and electrical tests of custom PCB’s. Flight Software implementation. Designed PCB test board for avionics hardware validation. Command and Data Handling. Ground Control Command and Telemetry Database development. Construction of satellite mock-up for harnessing measurements

positions.description: Staffed in the Space Exploration Sector. Worked in cooperation with the Ground Control Software group as well as the Integration and Testing group to assist in the development of a software application for utilization on NASA's DART mission (a planetary defense mission) and further I&T purposes. Developed Selenium scripts (integration tests) in Java for the automated testing of the software application. Manually tested software application to increase robustness. positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Primarily worked on writing test plans, conducting and documenting mechanical engineering research tests on aircraft thrust reversers, as well as designing and managing the fabrication of production tools. Research focused predominantly on stress attenuation methodology and investigation. Gained unique hands-on experiences through laying up carbon-composite structures, and working with several technicians in areas pertaining to composite structures.
